integrity: The verification script uses exact arbitrary-precision integer calculations; finite checks do not substitute for the general proof. No claim of independent mathematical validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Relies on the published individual-term formulas for the specified memory cycle; excludes the classical period-one Fibonacci sequence and arbitrary memory schedules. The two-parameter intersection classification is derived here; older equivalent coverage is possible.
title: Finite intersections and quadratic last coincidences of rotating-memory Fibonacci sequences
